image_description: A full suit of polished steel plate armor, specifically a Maximilian-style harness, displayed against a dark red background. The image focuses on the torso, featuring a fluted breastplate with a central ridge, pauldrons (shoulder guards) with circular decorative elements, and articulated arm defenses. A close helmet (armet or burgonet style) covers the head.
